statement: The specified A.22 pure multiplier-one involution and both norm-one conjugators lift to the quotient of Fhat2 whose index-three kernel is the free class-two pro-5 group on four generators. This quotient is nonmetabelian, with central second derived subgroup Z5. Compatible finite reductions have order 3*5^(10n) and second derived subgroup C_(5^n).

notes: Explicit rational BCH coordinates have denominators powers of3 and yield exact order-two, peripheral and norm identities on an infinite 5-adic quotient. The free class-two quotient's universal property and descent of pure multiplier-one substitutions are proved. The metabelian residues are identified with the specified A.22 idempotent equations.
